en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Ali Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Abu Islamil Al Sarraj, from Abu Imran, from a man,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having looked at a sandal with its straps tied, so Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> took hold of it and loosened it, then said: ‘Do not tie’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from abu ’Isma‘il al-Sarraj from ‘Imran from a man who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once looked at a shoe which had laces that were tied down. He (the Imam) picked it up, opened its laces and said, ‘This must not be tied down.’”
